# Tailor Homes

> Tailor Homes is a property management company based in Padova, Italy. We manage short and medium-term rentals, apartments and prestige villas, offer corporate housing for companies, and a 15% discount for UniPD and Erasmus students. Guests can book directly online.

Office: Via degli Obizzi 1, Padova, Italy. Email: info@tailorhomes.it. Phone / WhatsApp: +39 371 445 3904. Landline: +39 049 490 6189. The site is available in Italian and English.

## Book a stay

- [Book Now — direct booking engine](https://tailorhomes-new.kross.travel/): live availability, prices and secure booking for all our apartments and villas.
- [Gallery](https://tailorhomes.it/appartamenti/): photos of our apartments and villas in and around Padova.
- [Students & Erasmus](https://tailorhomes.it/studenti/): 15% off for UniPD and Erasmus students, verified via WhatsApp.
- [Corporate Housing](https://tailorhomes.it/alloggi-aziendali/): furnished stays for business trips, fairs, relocations and projects.

## Property owners

- [For Owners](https://tailorhomes.it/proprietari/): full property management, dynamic pricing, guest care 24/7, cleaning and maintenance.
- [Our Services](https://tailorhomes.it/i-nostri-servizi/): property management, home staging, photography, consulting and investments.
- [Contact](https://tailorhomes.it/contatti/): get a free assessment of your property.
